headline: Brazil Appoints Luiz Carlos Trabuco as Finance Minister
summary: Brazilian markets rallied as Luiz Carlos Trabuco was confirmed as the country's new Minister of Finance. Meanwhile, the Workers' Party congressional caucus reaffirmed its support for President Lula while calling for lower interest rates and tax changes.
why: Leadership appointments at the Finance Ministry directly shape fiscal policy, interest rate trajectories, and investor confidence in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: The appointment of a new finance minister directly boosted local equity market sentiment and index performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The confirmation of Luiz Carlos Trabuco as Finance Minister triggered a sharp rally in Brazilian equities, with the Ibovespa jumping nearly 4% as investors reacted to the new economic leadership.
